name: 12U CubeSat
description: A shoebox-sized satellite built from standard 10 cm cubes. Cheap and light, but it only fits tiny parts.

name: Small bus
description: A fridge-sized spacecraft frame with its computer, wiring and thrusters.

name: Medium bus
description: A car-sized spacecraft frame. Room for many instruments and big power systems.

name: Large bus
description: A bus-sized flagship spacecraft frame. Lots of room, lots of mass and a big price tag.
